Only active Rework 7 authority is executable; every earlier cockpit, investigation graph, KPI, panel, acceptance or validation requirement is HISTORICAL / NON-EXECUTABLE / SUPERSEDED BY REWORK 7.
At 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom render the Sidebar at x=0 y=0 w=164 h=1024, Topbar at x=164 y=0 w=1372 h=64 and main canvas at x=164 y=64 w=1372 h=960, within plus or minus 4 pixels.

Render second-row panels at Findings by Severity x=176 y=292 w=249 h=213, Top Risky Assets x=435 y=292 w=252 h=213, AI Insights x=697 y=292 w=241 h=213, AI Agents Status x=948 y=292 w=246 h=213 and Recent Decisions x=1204 y=292 w=277 h=213, with position and size tolerance plus or minus 4 pixels.

Render lower AI Agents at x=176 y=517 w=632 h=454 and selected-agent detail at x=808 y=517 w=722 h=454; both five-panel rows and the upper visible portion of the 632:722 split must appear in the first viewport.

Use outer content inset 12px left and nominal 10px right, horizontal panel gap 10px, first-to-second row gap 10px, second-row-to-lower gap 12px, panel padding 12px, table cells 8px 10px and compact controls 8px 10px, within plus or minus 3 pixels.
Use 1px panel/control borders, 6px panel radius and 4px compact-control radius within plus or minus 1 pixel.

Use typography anchors page title 20px/24px, greeting/workspace metadata 9px/14px, panel heading 11px/16px, lower heading 16px/22px, primary KPI 28px/34px, gauge value 32px/38px, labels/metadata 8px/12px, table 8px/13px and buttons/status chips 8px/12px within plus or minus 1 pixel.

Use measured color anchors shell/topbar #000411, sidebar #010717, main canvas #010817, panel #0C1423, border #1C212F, primary text #F0F0F0, secondary text #989FA5, purple #5728D2, success #19924A, warning #F59D19, danger #EF4444, information #0174E1 and disabled #64748B within plus or minus 8 per RGB channel.
No element may overlap unintentionally, be clipped or fall outside the reference viewport; truthful dynamic text may differ but geometry, hierarchy and styling remain within the numerical tolerances.
Reconstruct the complete visible Enterprise Sidebar hierarchy, branding, workspace area and Collapse control using only existing real URL-authoritative destinations.

Reconstruct the visible Topbar including Dashboard and Enterprise Workspace titles, greeting area, Last 7 Days, calendar/refresh, Explain This Dashboard, search, notifications, theme and operator area; remove fake identity and render unsupported controls truthfully.
The theme popover is closed by default and must match the reference interaction state only when explicitly opened during visual acceptance.

GET /api/findings is authoritative only for Total Findings and explicitly labeled vendor-severity aggregation; no Finding field may be reinterpreted as risk, exposure, trend, priority, confidence or impact.

GET /api/incidents may supply canonical incident rows and statuses, but no active lifecycle definition may be invented; Active Investigations remains Unavailable when no authoritative active-state definition exists.
Overall Risk Score, Risk Trend, Exposed Assets and Top Risky Assets remain Unavailable because Rework 7 has no approved productive read model for those values.
AI Insights remains Unavailable and opening or interacting with the dashboard must not invoke provider, model, reasoning or explanation generation.

AI Agents Status, AI Agents table and selected-agent detail render Not configured/empty within the reference geometry; never reinterpret the AI Model Registry as an agent inventory and never invent agents, status, performance, activity, capability, cost or pagination totals.
Recent Decisions remains Unavailable because no typed frontend Decision read boundary is authorized; do not use the legacy untyped engine response as dashboard truth.
Never copy any number, agent, identity, percentage, timestamp, confidence, cost, trend, activity or security conclusion from the visual reference into runtime product output.

Preserve existing Dashboard, Findings, Investigations, Assets, Threat Intelligence, Explainability, Exposure, Decision Center, Incident and Command Center routes and drill-down behavior, including Back, Forward, deep link, refresh and sidebar synchronization.

Explain This Dashboard routes through the existing Explainability boundary without executing a provider or fabricating an explanation, and TASK-0121 truthful Explainability-unavailable behavior remains unchanged.

DashboardPage composes the new EnterpriseSOCDashboard component; the eight explicitly prohibited legacy Investigation-cockpit files remain byte-identical and are neither adapted, deleted nor used as the Rework 7 visual architecture.
Loading, API error, empty and populated states preserve the reference geometry without fake fallback values or repetitive unavailable-card noise.

Focused tests cover EnterpriseSOCDashboard region order and geometry hooks, DashboardPage truthful projection and states, Sidebar/Topbar hierarchy and actions, layout, routing/history, theme popover and absence of provider execution or mock values.

Run focused EnterpriseSOCDashboard, DashboardPage, Sidebar, Topbar, layout and routing tests; full frontend regression in regular parallel mode and with maxWorkers=1; TypeScript; production build; git diff --check; Scope Guard; and reference SHA-256 verification.
Automated tests do not replace mandatory direct Product Owner screenshot comparison against the immutable PNG at 1536 x 1024 and 100 percent zoom.

Do not modify backend, API, domain, persistence, runtime, .env, provider execution, other workspaces, the immutable reference, TASK-0120 or TASK-0121; do not create TASK-0123, claim Product Owner PASS or transition TASK-0122 to DONE.
